gamemode_conquest_description.English: Raze all the other tribes' city from the face of the Square. Without any trace left.

gamemode_conquest_loss.English: Your last city was lost, you have been defeated.

gamemode_conquest_win.English: You have defeated all the other tribes and purified the entire Square!

gamemode_reign_win_last_human.English: You are the last standing human player, you win!

building_ability_citadel.English: Expands border of its city to adjacent tiles. You can train units on it and defence bonus is applied.

tooltip_ability_mountaincitadel.English: Unlocks Citadel on Mountain and provides defence bonus on tile.

tooltip_ability_watercitadel.English: Unlocks Citadel on Water and provides defence bonus on tile. Units that move here will turn into rammer.
